behavior: Actor binding uses domain-separated SHA-256 of authenticated user UUID; only opaque hash appears in sessionStorage key.
Logout/actor change discards in-memory payload, detaches promise, fences late ACK, and preserves original actor pending identity.
New v2 pending includes cleanupAttempt=false; persist true before cleanup POST, recover false only after applied GET, never retry uncertain cleanup.
Applied receipt with pending cleanup preserves identity and GET-only recovery; notify DB success only once per client.
Legacy v1 has no actor or cleanup-attempt evidence: retain and use original-operation GET only; never delete/replay on forbidden/uncertain readback.

Exact cleanup endpoint success=false with 423/RECORD_ACTION_MAINTENANCE or 503/RECORD_ACTION_MEDIA_NOT_ADMITTED proves no cleanup work. Persist cleanupAttempt=false and cleanupDeferred=true. Automatic reload remains GET-only; explicit existing-result readback can resume the same operation after applied GET. All other errors keep cleanupAttempt=true.
limits: No hosted authenticated browser/server or Storage validation.
Legacy unbound identities can remain blocked across accounts until their original successful readback; safe ownership cannot be inferred client-side.
